author: Syncfusion
name: Blazor Toolkit Web App
description: A project template for creating a Blazor web app that supports server-side rendering and WebAssembly interactivity using the Syncfusion Blazor Toolkit.
symbols/Framework/description: The target framework for the project.
symbols/skipRestore/description: Skip automatic NuGet package restore after project creation.
symbols/ExcludeLaunchSettings/descriptio: Exclude launchSettings.json from the generated project output.
symbols/kestrelHttpPort/description: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json.
symbols/kestrelHttpsPort/description: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json.
symbols/iisHttpPort/description: Port number to use for the IIS Express HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json.
symbols/iisHttpsPort/description: Port number to use for the IIS Express HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json.
symbols/InteractivityPlatform/descriptio: Select the interactive render mode for the Blazor Toolkit components
symbols/InteractivityPlatform/choices/We: Interactive rendering in the browser using WebAssembly
symbols/InteractivityPlatform/choices/Au: Uses Server while downloading WebAssembly assets, then uses WebAssembly
symbols/InteractivityLocation/descriptio: Chooses which components will have interactive rendering enabled
symbols/InteractivityLocation/choices/In: Interactivity is applied on a per-page or per-component basis
Interactivity is applied at the root level
symbols/AllInteractive/description: Enable interactive rendering globally (root-level) for all pages and components
symbols/IncludeSampleContent/description: Include sample pages and styling to demonstrate Blazor Toolkit usage
symbols/Empty/description: Generate an empty template without sample pages and styling
symbols/UseProgramMain/description: Whether to generate an explicit Program class and Main method instead of top-level statements.
symbols/LocalhostTld/displayName: Use the .dev.localhost TLD in the application URL
symbols/LocalhostTld/description: Whether to combine the project name with the .dev.localhost TLD in the application URL for local development.
postActions/restore/description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
